name: html.export
title: Export HTML
summary: Write the workspace as an HTML export into a folder: a start page `index.html` and one page per element without an invalid status, readable in a browser without network.
details: The folder is new, empty, or holds an earlier HTML export (its marker file `reqseq-html-export.yaml`): then the files that export wrote are replaced or removed, and every other file stays as it is and is named as a problem. Texts are written as text where they would run, load or link something outside the folder (raw HTML, links with another scheme than http, https or mailto, images from the network or outside the element's repository, Mermaid diagrams with click actions or HTML labels), each named as a problem. Formulas are set when the pages are written, and Mermaid diagrams are drawn by one copy of the library in the folder; a formula with an error shows its source and the error and is named as a problem. On an error the earlier export stays as it was.
whileReadOnlyReason: The pages show the types and statuses of the metamodel, which is missing or faulty.

output.description: The folder to write: a new folder, an empty folder, or the folder of an earlier HTML export. In a repository of the workspace, missing folders above it are created; outside the repositories, the folder above it must exist.

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: The written folder, relative to the workspace root when it lies inside, else absolute.

pages.title: Element pages
pages.description: Pages of elements written: one for each element of `exportedElements`.

removed.title: Removed files
removed.description: Files of the earlier export that this export no longer writes and removed.

exportedElements.title: List of exported elements
exportedElements.description: The elements that got a page, in the order of the element store.

incomplete.description: A repository of the workspace is not on this machine, so the pages lack its elements, as the start page says (SR-006 AK2, SR-233 AK3).
